mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies and a comfortable temperature of 73 degrees out at Reddan Soccer Park. We are in a first quarter moon phase, and tonight, you can spot the International Space Station as it passes from the direction of Cross Plains toward the Oregon area near Costco at 10:22 PM.

The City of Verona keeps the community informed through multiple channels including the VHAT cable channel, the official city blog, and a monthly digital newsletter. Residents are also reminded to follow city ordinances regarding vehicle parking, which require cars to be kept in designated spaces at least five feet from property lines.

It is a busy week in Verona. Today, you can visit the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market, enjoy live music at Paddy Mac's, or participate in Trivia Night at The Bogey Factory. Tomorrow, look forward to Concerts in the Park and trivia over at Hop Haus Brewing.
In a look at the weekly report, on July 13, officers responded to a situation where a 36-year-old driver was arrested for an O-W-I after their vehicle became trapped on a large rock.
Today's flavor is the refreshing Mint Explosion. The store is open until 10 PM tonight, which gives you plenty of time to grab a scoop before they close in a few hours.
